description: This source file defines data structures and functions for handling configuration schemas, including types for schema nodes, UI hints, and path segments, as well as utility functions for schema navigation and hint retrieval.

classes.name: ConfigUiHint
classes.description: Represents UI-related hints for configuration fields, initialized from a dictionary.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaNode
classes.description: Encapsulates a schema node, capable of parsing properties, types, defaults, and navigation within a JSON schema structure.

methods.name: decodeUiHints
methods.description: Decodes a dictionary of UI hints into a mapping from keys to ConfigUiHint instances.

methods.name: hintForPath
methods.description: Retrieves the most appropriate UI hint for a given configuration path, considering direct matches and wildcard patterns.

methods.name: isSensitivePath
methods.description: Determines if a configuration path is sensitive based on common keywords.

methods.name: pathKey
methods.description: Generates a string key representation for a configuration path, concatenating key segments.
